items.en:
Apocalyptic dust storms cloud the cruel sky, turning the sun first blood-red before rendering it a directionless glow which offers neither warmth nor comfort. 

The need for absolution spills from the mines, is forged in refineries, and then is assembled in orbit. Asher's virtue of industry is yet the Church's secret shame, spoken of only circuitously in sermons given by particularly spiritual curates.

Perseus "Saturnian" Andrada was killed in a botched operation involving "Doctor" Wyatt Cydonia. The goal was to perform a transfer of Philip Andrada's consciousness into a new clone-body. It was suggested that Philip Andrada's condition deteriorated too quickly for the operation to proceed as planned.

Hector "Cyrino" Andrada was an assistant academician at the Galatia Academy.

Now he is dead at the hand of professional assassins. You might have saved his life but chose not to warn him at the moment of the attack.

Documents describe the acquisition of a remote asteroid named Irkalla in the Duzakh system. An unusual, highly bio-technical operation was installed involving two very highly paid anonymous contractors. The identifier attached is "Leonidas Esculus".

You found Hector "Palatin" Andrada in a fortified asteroid in the Hybrasil system, 58966 Elysium.

You bombarded the asteroid until it was nothing more than a clump of radioactive rubble. If Hector was in there, he must be dead.

Documents describe the purchase of an asteroid base with pre-existing life-support and technical infrastructure in the Hybrasil system. It's been given the name Elysium, and has been operated by a rotating crew of support staff and elite private tutors. Staff turnover is high. There have been multiple emergency medical evacs. The identifier attached is "Hector Palatin"
The target ship takes {{30%}} more damage from all sources.

The ship's top speed is briefly increased to approximately {{600}} su/second.

After system deactivation, residual plasma in the engine manifolds provides greatly increased maneuverability for several seconds.

While the system is active, hardpoint weapons receive {{100%}} increased range and {{200%}} increased rate of fire. Recoil is reduced by {{75%}}, and projectile speed is increased by {{50%}}.

While the system is in passive mode, the range of all non-missile weapons is increased by {{35%}}.

Deals {{100 Energy}} and {{500 EMP}} damage per arc. The arcs can hit targets within approximately {{500}} su of the ship.

In addition, most missiles will have their guidance systems knocked out even if they are not destroyed outright.

Deals {{1500 EMP}} damage per arc to enemy ships. The system can hit targets within approximately {{1500}} su of the ship.

Only affects friendly ships if they have a {{lash-activated}} ship system.
